en.title: Two-Player Optimal Pick Difference
en.description:
You are given an integer array. Two players take turns picking any one of the remaining elements; both maximize the sum of their own scores, and the first player moves first. Output the first player's total minus the second player's total under optimal play.

The input/output protocol and the limits marked as 'added by this site' were compiled by this site; limits not given in the original problem are not treated as part of the original source.
en.input: The first line contains n; the second line contains n integers. Ranges added by this site: 1≤n≤200000, |points[i]|≤10^9.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the algorithm idea, proof of correctness, and complexity.
